description: This file contains utility functions for internal use, including string manipulation, object assignment, dependency resolution, version comparison, and safe require handling, primarily used within a TypeScript project.

methods.name: yn
methods.description: Converts string input to boolean based on common yes/no representations.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Merges multiple objects into the initial object, ignoring undefined properties.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a comma-separated string into an array, removing empty strings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into an object.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a string.

methods.name: hasOwnProperty
methods.description: Checks if an object has a property as its own (not inherited).

methods.name: cachedLookup
methods.description: Creates a cached version of a function to optimize repeated calls.

methods.name: attemptRequireWithV8CompileCache
methods.description: Requires a module with v8-compile-cache for faster subsequent loads, with error handling.

methods.name: createProjectLocalResolveHelper
methods.description: Creates a helper function to resolve project dependencies relative to a local directory.

methods.name: getBasePathForProjectLocalDependencyResolution
methods.description: Determines the base path for resolving project dependencies based on config and options.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Ensures a function is only executed once.

methods.name: versionGteLt
methods.description: Compares semantic versions to check if a version is greater than or equal to one requirement and less than another.
